title: Time-assisted link-layer replay rejection
description: Augment the epoch+seqnum sliding window with a wall-clock time check. Reject frames received outside [now - REPLAY_TIME_WINDOW, now] regardless of sequence number validity. REPLAY_TIME_WINDOW = 600s (2x ANNOUNCE_INTERVAL). Provides reboot resilience (time window survives without persisted per-sender seq state) and bounded memory (entries older than window are GC'd). This is an additional defense layer; epoch+seqnum remains primary. Spec: 06-security.md §15.3. All three impls.
